page_title: TOR 0-1 NAP | Torino v Napoli 01/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+4' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. David Neres (Napoli) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
90+3' Napoli take a short corner kick.

90+2' Vanja Milinkovic-Savic pulls off a great save to deny Giovanni Simeone (Napoli) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far! Napoli will take a corner kick.
90' 3 additional min. will be played.
89' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.

89' A player from Napoli commits a rough challenge. Michael Fabbri blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Torino win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
87' Antonio Conte has decided to substitute Romelu Lukaku and he is replaced by Giovanni Simeone (Napoli).
87' Michael Folorunsho (Napoli) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Frank Anguissa.
86' Michael Fabbri blows his whistle. Alieu Njie (Torino) commits a foul after dangerous play. Napoli get a free kick.
84' Samuele Ricci (Torino) has received a yellow card for his foul.
83' Yann Karamoh (Torino) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
81' The foul by Frank Anguissa (Napoli) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Michael Fabbri.
80' Substitution. David Neres (Napoli) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Khvicha Kvaratskhelia walks off.
80' Scott McTominay (Napoli) misses a complete sitter from the corner, heading the ball well wide of the left post from close in. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
80' Napoli have a corner.
79' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) inside the box following a slide rule pass. Now Napoli have a corner.
77' Saul Coco (Torino) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle. Napoli are awarded a free kick.
76' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Adam Masina departs the field of play to be replaced by Borna Sosa (Torino).
75' Paolo Vanoli prepares a substitution. Mergim Vojvoda is replaced by Yann Karamoh (Torino).
75' That will be all from Matteo Politano who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli).
74' Vanja Milinkovic-Savic comes off his line to intercept the corner from Matteo Politano (Napoli).
74' An attempted cross from Frank Anguissa (Napoli) is cleared. Napoli earn a corner.
73' Sebastian Walukiewicz (Torino) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
70' Alieu Njie (Torino) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
69' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Michael Fabbri saw the whole situation. A free kick is awarded to Napoli.
69' Che Adams (Torino) picks up a precise pass deep inside the box, but his strike is saved by the keeper.

65' Mathias Olivera (Napoli) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the left side of the goal. Vanja Milinkovic-Savic shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
65' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
64' Paolo Vanoli has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nikola Vlasic (Torino) replacing Karol Linetty.
64' Substitution. Antonio Sanabria leaves the pitch and is replaced by Alieu Njie (Torino).
61' Matteo Politano (Napoli) beats the defender to the ball in the box and shoots, but the ball flashes just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.

59' What a miss! The corner finds Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) unmarked in the box with the goal at his mercy, but somehow he mistimes his header and sends it just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
59' The ball goes out of play. Napoli are awarded a corner kick.
58' Napoli have been awarded a corner kick.
57' Matteo Politano (Napoli) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked. Napoli win a corner.
56' Saul Coco (Torino) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Michael Fabbri didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
56' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Mergim Vojvoda (Torino).
55' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
54' Mathias Olivera (Napoli) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.

52' The corner evades everyone in the centre and ends up at the back post where Valentino Lazaro (Torino) sends a wild header high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.
52' Torino force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
50' Scott McTominay (Napoli) trips an opposition player and Michael Fabbri signals a foul. Torino have a free kick.
50' Torino fail to score from a corner as Alex Meret (Napoli) leaps to collect the ball.
49' Mergim Vojvoda (Torino) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. The ball is out of play and Torino manage to earn a corner.
48' Flag up against Romelu Lukaku (Napoli). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.

48' That's unlucky! Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) side steps a tackle after receiving a pass, advances then hits a booming shot from mid-range which only rises at the last second to fly just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
47' Adam Masina (Torino) sends a cross into the box, but Alex Meret comes off his line to gather the ball.
46' Paolo Vanoli makes a half-time substitution. Valentino Lazaro comes on in place of Marcus Pedersen (Torino).
46' Referee Michael Fabbri blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
43' Sebastian Walukiewicz (Torino) commits a rough foul. Michael Fabbri stops the game and makes a call. Napoli win a free kick.

42' Antonio Sanabria (Torino) latches on to a precise lofted cross inside the box, controls the ball and unleashes a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. His dangerous effort is blocked by Alex Meret, who makes a glorious save!
41' Today's referee Michael Fabbri rightly decides to book Marcus Pedersen (Torino) for his harsh tackle.
40' Matteo Politano (Napoli) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
39' Michael Fabbri shows a yellow card to Sebastian Walukiewicz (Torino) for a tough tackle.
38' Matteo Politano (Napoli) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
38' Karol Linetty (Torino) tackles a bit over-zealously and Michael Fabbri blows for a foul. Napoli are awarded the free kick.
37' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.

36' Antonio Sanabria (Torino) has a good opportunity as he meets a cross on the edge of the six-yard box and heads it towards the target. One of the defenders stands on the goal line and manages to keep the ball out. Torino force their opponents to concede a corner.
36' Che Adams (Torino) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
36' Mergim Vojvoda (Torino) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
35' Adam Masina (Torino) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
35' Sebastian Walukiewicz (Torino) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
35' Samuele Ricci (Torino) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
33' Rough tackle by Gvidas Gineitis (Torino). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. Free kick. Napoli will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
31' 0 - 1 Scott McTominay (Napoli) receives a well-taken defence-splitting pass inside the box and scores! He buries the ball into the bottom left corner.
29' Poor challenge! Scott McTominay (Napoli) is penalised for tripping and Michael Fabbri blows his whistle. That's a free kick to Torino.
28' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) jumps for a header from the resulting set piece, but it goes way wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
28' Matteo Politano (Napoli) takes the corner.

27' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Napoli.
26' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Marcus Pedersen (Torino) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
25' One of the players from Napoli times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
24' A brilliant cross into the box finds Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli), who directs his header towards the top left corner, but the goalkeeper shows all his agility and makes an astonishing save.
24' Michael Fabbri has a clear sight and sees a foul from Adam Masina (Torino). It's a free kick to Napoli in a dangerous position.
23' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) latches onto a cross inside the box and aims a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic reacts superbly to deny him.
19' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
18' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) is first to the rebound inside the box but sends his effort high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
18' Scott McTominay (Napoli) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
14' Sebastian Walukiewicz (Torino) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Michael Fabbri blows for a foul. Napoli will take a free kick near the side line.
11' A cross into the box from Matteo Politano (Napoli) is cleared.
10' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.

9' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) inside the box. He lets fly towards the bottom left corner, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
8' Matteo Politano (Napoli) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
7' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Matteo Politano (Napoli), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. Napoli get a corner.

5' Mathias Olivera (Napoli) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Michael Fabbri with no other option than to blow for a foul. Torino have a free kick.
4' Che Adams (Torino) latched on to a lofted pass inside the box, but his header misses to the right of the target. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Napoli.
3' Napoli are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Torino will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Michael Fabbri.
